rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for stating a consequence or conclusion.

example.english: It was raining, therefore I brought an umbrella.
example.jyutping: lok6 jyu5 so2 ji5 ngo5 daai3 zo2 ze1

rows.note: Use this conversationally when the consequence follows immediately from the situation or what was just said.

example.english: You do not eat breakfast, therefore you will get hungry.
example.traditional: 你唔食早餐，咁就會肚餓。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sik6 zou2 caan1 gam2 zau6 wui5 tou5 ngo6

rows.note: Choose this formal written equivalent in essays, reports, and other polished prose.

example.english: They did not submit the documents; therefore, the application could not be processed.
example.traditional: 佢未有提交文件，因此申請未能處理。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mei6 jau5 tai4 gaau1 man4 gin6 jan1 ci2 san1 cing2 mei6 nang4 cyu5 lei5
